tasks_output.raw: A 45-year-old Pacific Islander female, 5'1", 120 lbs, reports no allergies, medications, or supplements. She follows a low-carb/keto vegetarian diet, exercises 3x/week, and has a work stress level of 6. She experiences frequent headaches/migraines, chronic pain, TMJ disorder, and trouble staying asleep, waking 1x/night and not feeling refreshed. She had mold exposure in 2010. Hormonal concerns include severe headaches, joint pain, hot flashes, weight gain, and broken sleep. Flagged biomarkers show high Iron (102.0 mcg/dL), AST:ALT Ratio (2.93), Total Protein (7.8 g/dL), Triglycerides (102.0 mg/dL), Lp(a) (25.6 mg/dL), HbA1c (6.1%), LDL:HDL Ratio (2.11), BUN:Creatinine Ratio (23.18), EAG (128.37 mg/dL), Triglyceride:HDL Ratio (1.88), VLDL (20.39 mg/dL), LH (32.32 mIU/mL), LDL Cholesterol (113.6 mg/dL), Aspartate Aminotransferase (44.0 U/L), and FSH (79.64 mIU/mL). Low markers include Calcium (8.4 mg/dL), Bilirubin (0.1 mg/dL), LDL-C:ApoB Ratio (1.32), 25-(OH) Vitamin D (24.0 ng/mL), and DHEA-S (120.4 mcg/dL).
